name: Excel Cell Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1981 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, Excel Cell Electronic Co., Ltd. is a key manufacturer and supplier of electronic components. Their extensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of electromechanical components. This covers various switches—such as pushbutton, selector, pilot lamp, emergency stop, key selector, DIP, slide, push, and micro switches, along with their accessories—as well as multiple relay types like Mos, reed, solid state, and electromechanical relays, complemented by reed sensors and sockets. They also provide numerous terminal blocks, including Eurostyle PCB, plug-in, screwless, high power, and wire-to-PCB configurations. Further electromechanical offerings extend to a broad selection of connectors (including FPC, board-to-board, board-to-wire, USB, I/O, battery, EPJ, and machine pin socket types), chip inductors, beads, resettable fuses, and stepping motors. Beyond this, the company excels in stamping products, producing lead frames for discrete device/integrated circuit semiconductors and photoelectric products, heat spreaders for IC/BGA applications, and other high-precision electronic components. Excel Cell Electronic's components are crucial for a wide array of applications across diverse industries, such as industrial control and instrumentation, security systems, consumer electronics and household appliances, computer peripherals, network and communication infrastructure, optoelectronics, power energy, and automotive electronics.
